atoms.text: Northern England has a Roman and Viking past. Nowadays, the region is mainly known for its mountains and lakes. There are two big cities in Northern England: Manchester and Newcastle.

hint.label: Vocabulary

atoms.text: Manchester is located in the South-West of Northern England. The city is famous for its industrial past and gothic architecture alongside modern buildings as well as its football clubs Manchester United and Manchester City.
atoms.sound: Manchester is located in the South West of Northern England. The city is famous for its industrial past and gothic architecture alongside modern buildings as well as its football clubs Manchester United and Manchester City.

atoms.text: Newcastle is the most populated city in Northern England. Newcastle is also famous for its ferry ports. The ferries regularly go from Newcastle to the Netherlands. There are also cruise ships departing from Newcastle that go to Scandinavia.
atoms.sound: Newcastle is the most populated city in Northern England. Newcastle is also famous for its ferry ports. The ferries regularly go from Newcastle to the Netherlands. There are also cruise ships departing from Newcastle that go to Scandinavia.

atoms.a: Where do ferries and cruise ships go to from Newcastle?

atoms.b: The “Lake District” is a national park in the north-west of Northern England. It is known for its beautiful ((++landscapes industries)). A lot of authors and poets were inspired by it. It's also a popular holiday destination for the Brits.
atoms.sound: The Lake District is a national park in the north-west of Northern England. It is known for its beautiful landscapes. A lot of authors and poets were inspired by it. It's also a popular holiday destination for the Brits.

atoms.b: There are many ((++lakes cities)), hills and some mountains in the national park. The highest mountain is called “Scafell Pike”. It is 978 m tall and the tallest mountain in ((++England Wales)).

instruction.text: Cedric macht gerade Urlaub in England. Er schreibt einen Brief an seine Freundin Morgan, die in Wales lebt. </br>Ziehe die Wörter in die passenden Lücken, um den Brief zu vervollständigen.
instruction.sound: Cedric macht gerade Urlaub in England. Er schreibt einen Brief an seine Freundin Morgan, die in Wales lebt. Ziehe die Wörter in die passenden Lücken, um den Brief zu vervollständigen.

trainers.finishSound: Dear Morgan. I spent the last days hiking in the Lake District. The landscape is really beautiful. We should go there again some day! Yesterday, we travelled all the way from Newcastle in the North to Brighton in the South. We're going to spend the last days on the coast. I might go for a swim in the English Channel. Yours, Cedric.
